title: Big Dhamaka
desc: Two men look alike, with one of them being a successful businessman and the other trying to find work. However, despite their differences, they end up falling for the same woman.

title: Tehkikaat
desc: When the charred remains of a young woman are found on the outskirts of the city, it leads investigators down a twisted path to find the culprit.
When mobiles start flying from people's hands, Dr Vaseegaran and his robot Nila are asked to help. However, due to Pakshi Rajan having a hand in this, the two have to reinstate Chitti to defeat him.

title: Shankar IPS
desc: Shankar, an upright police officer, decides to bring the culprit to justice when a business tycoon's son attacks a woman with acid and escapes punishment.

title: Thanal
desc: When life's unrelenting test pushes two people to the brink, one person rises as the hero and the other falls into darkness, becoming a villain.

title: 5D
desc: A police officer investigates a series of murders in Bengaluru. Soon, his findings help him discover the dark side of the victims.
